clips.title: The story
paras: Olsen's Farthing lies in ruin beside Silverpine Forest's main trade road. Since the Third War, reanimated thralls have overrun its fields.

Olsen's Farthing once worked the fields beside Silverpine's main trade road. Now weeds choke the farmland, and broken buildings mark the loss of the farmstead. Undead thralls roam the grounds, bound to serve and raid under Thule Ravenclaw. Travelers who stray too close risk being slaughtered.
